summary: Halozyme (HALO) closed a $1.5B private placement of 1.50% Convertible Senior Notes due 2033, including the $200M initial-purchaser option. Net proceeds were about $1,471.1M; roughly $187.5M funded capped-call transactions. The company expects to repurchase approximately $151.7M of 0.25% 2027 notes and $220.0M of 1.00% 2028 notes, with total repurchase costs stated for the 2027 tranche. Notes were sold to qualified institutional buyers under Rule 144A and are unregistered. Key angles: capped-call dilution mitigation, unregistered share overhang, and liability-management execution.
